node.title: Generated-field-guarded F2 extras-budget close
node.statement: At every official prize-max row and depth where the consumer's banked generated-field guard |B0|^t>=2^n invokes F2, prove that non-coset-union F2 extras plus trade families are at most n^3=2^123. The July Myerson close and the all-row bounded-class reduction are invalid. The plus generating branch reduces to explicit GRS kernels and the minus generating branch to one coupled negacyclic kernel. Fixed-depth ambient invariance identifies extension-row objects with generated-field objects, but does not transport a depth calibrated using the ambient q. The proved guard/depth reconciliation shows that the full-subset balance (C) selects exactly the five signed generating types, while an exact-slice (T*) depth fails the F2 guard on every type and must use a different route unless the guard is explicitly replaced. Under (C), the working finite mass terminal is Z(L)<=1+n^3; its proof, PP5.0 normalization, and any coset-sensitive Frobenius step remain open. No consumer status is promoted.
